_comment: The topic hubs at /topics/<slug>/. Proposed 2026-10-09 from the episodes' summaries and takeaways (content/topics-proposal.json has the per-episode reasoning); the team confirms or edits names, descriptions and questions here. Each episode's `topics` list in content/episodes/<id>.json names these slugs, primary first.

topics.name: AI skills and careers
topics.description: Which skills to learn, how hiring is changing, and how to position yourself as AI takes over routine work.
topics.question: What should I learn to stay employable as AI changes work?

topics.name: Future of work
topics.description: What economists, CEOs and labour data say about which jobs AI will change or remove, how fast, and what comes next.
topics.question: Which jobs will AI change or replace, and how soon?

topics.name: AI business and startups
topics.description: Business ideas, founder playbooks and step-by-step guides for starting and growing a company in the AI era, often without code, funding or a team.
topics.question: How do I start a business with AI, without funding or a technical team?

topics.name: Leadership and mindset
topics.description: How founders and CEOs built and run their companies: co-founders, scaling, hard decisions, burnout, and the habits and life lessons behind their careers.
topics.question: What does it actually take to build and lead a company, and keep going?

topics.name: AI tools and workflows
topics.description: The specific tools, agents and automation setups Marina and her guests use day to day, and how to set them up yourself.
topics.question: Which AI tools and agent workflows are worth setting up, and how?

topics.name: AI safety and the future
topics.description: How powerful AI may become, how fast, what could go wrong, and who ends up controlling it.
topics.question: How far will AI go, and what are the risks?

topics.name: Education and learning
topics.description: Whether degrees still pay off, how schools are changing, and how adults and children should learn alongside AI.
topics.question: Is a degree still worth it, and how should I or my kids learn in the AI era?

topics.name: Creator economy and personal brand
topics.description: Building an audience, getting found by people and AI assistants, and turning content into income through brands, email, products and affiliates.
topics.question: How do I build an audience and make money from it?

topics.name: Money and investing
topics.description: Personal finance, investing, income streams and the money habits behind building wealth.
topics.question: How do I manage, grow and diversify my money?

topics.name: Health and science
topics.description: How AI and new science are changing medicine, biology and physics, and how to use AI for your own health.
topics.question: How is AI changing medicine and science, and how should I use it for my health?
